insight_source_id.title: Insight Source ID
insight_source_id.description: Unique identifier for this BambooHR connector instance (e.g., 'bamboohr-acme-prod').

bamboohr_api_key.title: BambooHR API Key
bamboohr_api_key.description: BambooHR API key for authentication. Found in BambooHR > Account > API Keys.

bamboohr_domain.title: BambooHR Domain
bamboohr_domain.description: Your BambooHR subdomain (e.g., 'acme' from acme.bamboohr.com). The bare subdomain only — not a full hostname or URL.

bamboohr_start_date.title: Start Date
bamboohr_start_date.description: Start date for leave requests history (ISO format YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 2020-01-01 if not set.
